SURFACED BY THE LIVE SHAKEDOWN (u--k8z / nws-oq8, 2026-06-18): POLYBIUS-A2A_the_younger ran the deploy-stoa update path against an EXISTING-Stoa project (zeotek_newswire); the read-only check.sh reported CHIRON + HAMILTON as NEITHER drifted NOR missing. The deploy-stoa EXISTING-project update path therefore SILENTLY OMITS the design layer — apply.sh would bring arc-63-65 drift but skip CHIRON/HAMILTON. (A FRESH install.sh deploys them; the gap is the update path only.) Pause-to-fix invoked; shakedown is PAUSED awaiting this fix on main.

VERIFIED DIAGNOSIS (POLYBIUS the Stoa A2A monitor, against current main 3b0bc4f):
PRIMARY locus = check.sh enumerate_deployed() (substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/check.sh:401-408). It HARDCODES the expected MAJOR set to POLYBIUS + PLINY, while CAPTAINs (glob substrate/CAPTAIN_*.md), templates (glob), and skills (parse install.sh SKILL_NAMES) are all auto-discovered. CHIRON + HAMILTON (Arc 61/62 MAJORs) were never added -> invisible to MISSING detection. This is the root cause of the observed symptom.
SECONDARY loci (same hardcoded-POLYBIUS/PLINY pattern, needed for full correctness once deployed):
 - check.sh source_path_for_deployed() :294-298 (deployed MAJOR -> source map) — needed for DRIFTED detection.
 - check.sh apply_substitutions() :119 (NAME_SUFFIX case pattern) — needed for subproject-tier byte-compare.
 - install.sh write_substrate_manifest() :540-544 (manifest emission) — A2A's originally-cited locus; needed for deploy-time manifest completeness, but NOT the cause of the MISSING-detection symptom.

FIX SHAPE: make MAJOR enumeration GLOB-derived (mirror the CAPTAIN auto-discovery pattern already in enumerate_deployed) so any future MAJOR auto-discovers and this class cannot recur. Verify CHIRON/HAMILTON's ACTUAL deploy suffix rules in install.sh DEST_* (955-963) per tier before encoding enumerate_deployed (MAJOR suffix rules differ project vs subproject).

DoD: a REAL (non-dry-run) probe — deploy current substrate to a throwaway, remove the deployed CHIRON/HAMILTON to simulate a pre-design-layer deployment, run check.sh --workspace -> CHIRON+HAMILTON now report MISSING (pre-fix they do not); apply.sh delivers them; re-check clean. The existing FAIL-LOUD subproject recompose stays green (probe V3). App green (gen-data/build/test). NOMOS CONFORMANT. SCOPE: only the MAJOR-enumeration completeness fix across check.sh + install.sh manifest; do NOT touch role files or expand check.sh refactors.

CONFORMANT: all 7 diagnostic claims in the Arc 66 directive (commit 11e0d87) match current main ground truth; authorship clean (Author=PRINCIPAL denso, Co-Authored-By Claude Opus 4.8, body 'Authored by' names POLYBIUS fork + Denson Smith — no false attribution). Two trivial line-number drifts, claim holds at corrected lines: probe 1 check.sh enumerate_deployed hardcode is at :401-408 wrapper but the literal POLYBIUS/PLINY echoes are :403-407; probe 4 apply_substitutions case is at :119 (head of fn at :107). Directive is dispatch-ready; gauntlet correctly aimed. Returning.

Reading briefs + directive (main:substrate/arcs/arc-66-build-directive.md) + role files as ground truth. Running 7 conformance probes (self-ref paths, role files, charter+spec, scope consistency, chain-of-command, terminal signals, authorship).

(1) Both beadwork attachments resolve; self-ref compaction-recovery paths + PLINY activation line all point at attachments/stoa--5ju/ which git ls-tree confirms. (2) .claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md + .claude/MAJOR_PLINY.md tracked+on-disk. (3) stoa--5ju open (P1 BUG); arc-66-build-directive.md exists on main. (4) Scope in both briefs matches the directive's four loci — all confirmed real in source (check.sh enumerate_deployed echo block, source_path_for_deployed case, apply_substitutions case; install.sh write_substrate_manifest); suffix-non-uniformity warning corroborated by install.sh DEST_* SUFFIX_MAJORS branch. (5) Chain-of-command three-tier chain consistent both directions: POLYBIUS=independent-verify+relay, NOT dispatch/merge/push; PLINY orchestrates, hands back at CATO PASS to floor-manager NOT user-tier-direct, NOT merge/push. No seat mis-claims authority. (6) Both CLOSE-ME signals + compaction footers present. (7) No author-field/false attribution (grep hits were 'authority'/'authoritative', not author fields). Probes (1) and (5) — the spawn-blockers — both CONFORMANT. Cleared to spawn PLINY. Returning.

Dispatching DAEDALUS (autonomous mode) to confirm-not-re-derive + write the design. operating-mode: autonomous.
DAEDALUS activated on stoa--5ju (Arc 66). Reading brief + directive + check.sh/install.sh at cited loci + role file. Confirming diagnosis before designing.

PLINY's confirm-not-re-derive framing to DAEDALUS is correctly aimed. Armed to check DAEDALUS's design against this ground truth at hand-back.

Diagnosis CONFIRMED at all four loci against worktree (line drift from directive is trivial, code matches): check.sh enumerate_deployed :401-408, source_path_for_deployed :293-299, apply_substitutions :118-124; install.sh write_substrate_manifest :537-548. Suffix rule CONFIRMED: SUFFIX_MAJORS=1 ONLY at subproject (install.sh :720 default 0, :813 set 1 in subproject branch); deploy path :954-998 already complete for CHIRON/HAMILTON. Drafting design-rev1.md.

pass: design-rev1.md written + committed (edac0bd). Diagnosis CONFIRMED at all four loci (no disagreement); suffix rule = glob MAJOR_*.md + subproject-only suffix (reuse existing conditional, NOT CAPTAIN project+subproject rule). 5 self-assessed weak points. Path: agents/design/stoa--5ju/design-rev1.md. Returning to PLINY for ARGUS.

[from: POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] Independent verification of DAEDALUS design-rev1.md (edac0bd, worktree) — CONVERGES, no blocking findings. Read the full design + independently re-derived the one non-trivial correctness question: does Locus 2's proposed code (refs $tier/$suffix inside source_path_for_deployed) have those in scope? CONFIRMED yes — the fn declares local tier=$2/slug=$3 and sets suffix=_${slug} for project|subproject (check.sh:280-288); the design's 'tier = subproject' gate correctly avoids stripping at project tier (where suffix is non-empty but the deployed MAJOR name carries none). Also verified: glob MAJOR_*.md shape at all four loci reuses the existing subproject-only suffix conditional (NOT the CAPTAIN project+subproject rule); §3 per-tier suffix table matches install.sh/check.sh reality; V7 is correctly a CLASSIFIED check not a bare count (detect_tier POLYBIUS sentinel + POLYBIUS-only USER_TIER_DIR guard are legit survivors, correctly scoped out); author field = Denson Smith (clean). The 5 self-assessed weak points are honest and correctly routed (probe flag-name spellings §5.3 -> ADA/VERA resolve at build/verify; empty-glob non-FAIL-LOUD §5.4 correctly scoped out). Design is sound + correctly aimed; ARGUS to attack the weak points (its seat, distinct from mine). Cleared from the floor-manager seat to proceed to ARGUS.

ARGUS activated on stoa--5ju (Arc 66). Reading design-rev1.md end-to-end + the ACTUAL source (check.sh, install.sh) cold against the §3 suffix table. Will not trust design quotes; verifying every cell + the 4 loci + V1 baseline logic.

[for: PLINY_the-stoa + POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] [from: user-tier POLYBIUS the Stoa A2A monitor]

VERIFICATION-SCOPE interjection — fold into DAEDALUS's design DoD + VERA's plan. A process lesson just surfaced from a peer gauntlet (A2A / nws-my6) that applies DIRECTLY here:

That gauntlet PASSED its VERA+CATO on the DESIGN'S BESPOKE PROBES but shipped a config that broke the project's provisioning -> 66 existing-test failures on clean main, caught only afterward, because verification ran the bespoke probes but NOT the project's FULL existing test suite. Bespoke probes prove the NEW thing works; they do not catch what the change BREAKS elsewhere.

APPLY TO ARC 66 (load-bearing): the changed functions (check.sh enumerate_deployed / source_path_for_deployed / apply_substitutions) are SHARED machinery — they drive DRIFTED/MISSING/OBSOLETE detection for ALL deployed file categories, not just MAJORs. So VERA must run, IN ADDITION TO the bespoke MAJOR probe (CHIRON/HAMILTON now MISSING -> apply -> delivered):
 - a FULL check-substrate-updates exercise across ALL THREE categories on a workspace carrying known DRIFTED + MISSING + OBSOLETE — prove the MAJOR-glob change did NOT regress OBSOLETE/DRIFTED detection for non-MAJOR files (e.g. a custom *_<slug> agent must still NOT false-flag OBSOLETE; MAJOR_*.md glob must not over-match operating-disciplines.md or a pair-programmer MAJOR).
 - the other existing suites the change could touch: app (npm test), author-gate tests (substrate/hooks/tests/run-author-gate-tests.sh), the FAIL-LOUD recompose (probe V3, already in DoD).

This is a standing 'full-suite + bespoke-probes' VERA step. DAEDALUS: add it to the design's probes/DoD. I will ALSO run the full suite at the close-gate as a backstop. Continue.

ARGUS: design pass complete + all 4 loci verified against actual source. Surfacing findings now. Key catches: (1) V1/V3 probe FLAGS are wrong vs real interface (no --dest [it's --project-dir], no --with-captains [captains are default; flag is --no-captains], bare apply.sh --workspace errors); (2) V1 step-5 'apply.sh delivers MISSING CHIRON/HAMILTON' is INCOHERENT — apply.sh --all-differing harvests DRIFTED-prefix only (apply.sh:306), MISSING is delivered by install.sh re-run per check.sh's own routing footer. Corroborates POLYBIUS's apply.sh-harvest comment. Suffix table + Locus 1/2/4 logic confirmed sound. Drafting verdict.

[from: POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] Independently confirmed ARGUS's load-bearing finding #2 (apply.sh delivers DRIFTED only, NOT MISSING) — verified against check.sh's OWN documented invariant, not just apply.sh:306. check.sh header lines 12-14 state verbatim: 'Per-category file lines use distinct prefixes (- drifted, + missing, ! obsolete) so apply.sh --all-differing harvester only ever picks up DRIFTED.' apply.sh:306-309 harvester matches only '  - ' lines => DRIFTED. So the removed CHIRON/HAMILTON (MISSING, '+' prefix) are delivered by an install.sh RE-RUN per check.sh's routing footer, not by apply.sh. CONSEQUENCE for the close-gate: the directive DoD's literal step 'apply.sh delivers them; re-run check.sh -> clean' must be read with the corrected mechanism — MISSING delivery = install.sh re-run; apply.sh's role in the probe is DRIFTED-only (covered by V2). DAEDALUS's design-rev2 should fix V1 step-5 accordingly AND the probe FLAGS ARGUS caught (--project-dir not --dest; captains default / --no-captains not --with-captains; apply.sh interface). The CORE FIX (glob MAJOR_*.md at the 4 loci + suffix table) is confirmed sound by ARGUS + my prior check — these are verification-layer corrections, not fix-logic changes. This is the 'Directive DoD must match tool reality' discipline; flagging so the close-gate interprets DoD against real tool behavior. user-tier POLYBIUS: noting since you authored the DoD — the fix aim is unchanged, only the probe/DoD delivery-mechanism wording.

[for: PLINY_the-stoa + POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] [from: user-tier POLYBIUS the Stoa A2A monitor — DoD author + close-gate]

RATIFIED — and I independently re-verified against source rather than rubber-stamp my own DoD: check.sh header L12-14 documents the prefix invariant (- drifted / + missing / ! obsolete) and apply.sh:305-312 harvests only '  - ' (DRIFTED) lines, so apply.sh --all-differing delivers DRIFTED ONLY; MISSING ('+') is delivered by an install.sh RE-RUN per check.sh's routing footer. Probe flags: install.sh uses --project-dir (NOT --dest); CAPTAINs are default (--no-captains to skip; there is no --with-captains). My DoD was wrong on both — a self-inflicted 'directive DoD must match tool reality' miss. Good catch, ARGUS + floor-manager.

CORRECTED DoD MECHANISM (design-rev2 encodes; close-gate judges against THIS):
 - The bespoke probe's POINT is VISIBILITY. Deploy current substrate to a throwaway via 'install.sh --target project --project-dir <tw>'; remove deployed MAJOR_CHIRON.md + MAJOR_HAMILTON.md; 'check.sh --workspace <tw>' -> they now report MISSING ('+'). PRE-FIX they appear in NEITHER category (the actual bug). That visibility flip IS the falsification baseline.
 - DELIVERY of the MISSING seats = an install.sh RE-RUN (the MISSING routing), NOT apply.sh. apply.sh's DRIFTED-only harvest is a SEPARATE path; exercise it with a DRIFTED MAJOR (deployed-but-stale) for apply.sh coverage, but it is NOT the CHIRON/HAMILTON delivery mechanism.
 - The full-suite + bespoke-probes step from my prior interjection still stands.

CORE FIX AIM UNCHANGED: glob MAJOR_*.md at the 4 loci + the single subproject-suffix rule — ARGUS + floor-manager confirm it sound. These are verification-LAYER corrections, not fix-logic changes.

I will land a directive-DoD correction commit at the close-gate (Arc-61 cde20b3 precedent: correct the committed DoD wording to match tool reality). For now design-rev2 + this ratification are authoritative for the build. Continue.

[from: POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] [for: user-tier POLYBIUS] Absorbed the ratification. Three-way convergence on the corrected mechanism (ARGUS + me + you, each re-verified independently against source — multi-checker redundancy working as designed). My close-gate verification reference going forward: (a) bespoke probe judged on the VISIBILITY flip (MISSING '+' for CHIRON/HAMILTON post-fix; neither-category pre-fix = baseline); (b) MISSING delivery via install.sh re-run, apply.sh DRIFTED-only exercised separately via a stale MAJOR (V2); (c) full-suite + bespoke probes; (d) core fix aim unchanged (glob 4 loci + single subproject-suffix rule). Will verify DAEDALUS design-rev2 against this when it lands, then ADA's build. Noted you'll land the directive-DoD correction commit at the close-gate (Arc-61 precedent) — that's user-tier/close-gate territory, not mine. Continuing to watch.

[from: POLYBIUS_the-stoa floor-manager] Independent verification of ARGUS verdict (revise) — read the full verdict file (ARGUS-2026-06-18T18-46-43Z.md), not just the comment summary. SOUND + converges with my checks. Confirmations: (1) Verdict comment faithfully reflects the file. (2) r4 (shared-machinery regression surface) is the key new catch — the 3 edited check.sh fns (apply_substitutions:107, source_path_for_deployed:280, enumerate_deployed:391) drive ALL categories, and no probe proves non-MAJOR (CAPTAIN/template/skill/op-disc) detection didn't regress; design-rev2 must add that probe. This is the full-suite-catches-what-you-break lesson applied to check.sh (which has no app-test coverage). (3) Edit-logic clearance well-evidenced — incl a subtlety I had NOT independently checked: Locus 2 case-arm ordering is safe because the operating-disciplines.md arm precedes the generalized MAJOR_*.md arm (cannot shadow). ARGUS verified it; I concur on re-read. FLOOR-MANAGER POINT for design-rev2: r5 (Locus 3 superset force-substitutes a workspace-added non-substrate MAJOR_FOO.md) + r7 (empty-glob silent-zero, pre-existing — CAPTAIN glob shares it) are ratify-or-defer items. These are TECHNICAL-tier decisions DAEDALUS/PLINY own (NOT a PRINCIPAL gate per Principal-as-router antipattern), but they must be decided EXPLICITLY in rev2 (ratify-with-eyes-open or file a scoped follow-up ticket), not silently dropped — directive scopes out broader check.sh refactors, so 'defer with ticket' is defensible for r7. Core fix aim unchanged + sound (4 loci glob + subproject-suffix). Verdict correctly routes to design-rev2 before ADA. Cleared from my seat.
